research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance and distractor placement to assess evidence use in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and citation support across retrieval conditions, separating failures associated with missing evidence from unsupported generation.

research.title: Lexical Shortcut Reliance in Natural Language Inference
bullets: Designed experiments using lexical overlap controls and label-preserving sentence edits to examine shortcut reliance in natural language inference models.
Analyzed prediction changes across linguistic challenge sets, distinguishing sensitivity to superficial vocabulary cues from errors involving negation and argument structure.

publications.title: Separating Lexical Overlap from Semantic Evidence in Natural Language Inference

work.title: Support Ticket Classification and Text Processing
bullets: Implemented text normalization and input validation for support ticket processing, handling malformed records and inconsistent category labels.
Maintained a ticket classification component and added regression tests covering preprocessing behavior, prediction interfaces, and empty input handling.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sparse and Dense Document Retrieval
bullets: Implemented sparse term weighting and dense embedding retrieval baselines over a shared document collection with consistent query preprocessing.
Compared retrieval rankings using relevance judgments and inspected disagreements involving rare terminology, paraphrased queries, and documents with overlapping vocabulary.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented token classification and conditional random field decoding baselines for named entity recognition using a common training split.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors, ambiguous names, and decoding behavior under inconsistent token-level predictions.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Positional and Graph-Based Baselines
bullets: Implemented lead sentence selection and graph-based sentence ranking for extractive summarization with matched token budgets and shared sentence segmentation.
Compared lexical overlap scores and manually inspected summaries for redundancy, omitted central claims, and dependence on document structure.
